as_told.title: Fitts: missing Pentagon money funds the breakaway civilization

plain: The claim is that trillions of dollars have gone missing from the budget of the Department of Defense and were quietly spent on secret projects. It comes from a woman named Catherine Austin Fitts, and Michels passes it on himself. An online researcher known as UAPGerb puts a figure on it: Fitts, he says, talks of "17 to 21 trillion" hidden in the secret US budget since the 1990s. The UFO historian Richard Dolan says Fitts told him that his idea of a "breakaway civilization" is "right on." By that he means a hidden group that has broken away from the rest of society, with advanced technology of its own. If true, it would mean huge sums of public money are paying for programs no one voted on.
